text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora looked unwell,
so I took her to the infirmary.
choice_data_list: No messing with your phone, just get some rest, you hear?
Don't play on your phone, just get some rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I know, geez...
Good night.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Nga?
What... Where am I—

text_block_list.name: Slo-th
text_block_list.text:
“Ribbit-laaaze, croak!
I'll turn everyone into slackers, croak!”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Hey! What are you daydreaming for?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate,
the whole town will be full of lazy bums!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I shall swiftly transform into "Carrot Angel"
and strike them down!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's it!
—"Perfume Set!" "Ready!"

text_block_list.name: Slo-th
text_block_list.text:
You're wide open!
Slacker Beam!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: —Kyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep & Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
"—Magic is such a paaaain.
—Being a princess is such a drag, desu wa~."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Majorica! Powerful!
...Wait, huh? Am I the only one it didn't work on?

text_block_list.name: Slo-th
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! Don't go slacking off on your own, ribbit?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well~ Time to wrap this up quickly~!
If everyone slacks off, I won't get to slack off!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Take this! "Carrot Lovely!
Genius Angel Sparkle!"

text_block_list.name: Slo-th
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaah!
I don't wanna work, ribbit! Ribbiiiit~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you, Carrot Angels!”
“—You guys really saved us!”
“—Starting tomorrow, I'll stop slacking off and work hard!”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh. This is our duty.
No thanks are necessary!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Well, this Angel is going to make a cool exit.
Wait—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Carrot Lovely is the strongest!
—Cute, cool, and a total genius!
—Sign an autograph for me~~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe~♡ Right, right~?
Wasn't I super cool~♡

text_block_list.name: Sweep & Kawakami
text_block_list.text: *Faceplants!*

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufufu♪ Praise me more, praise me more♡
Because if you do, I can do e~ven better♡♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —*Yaaaaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe, I feel like I was having a nice dream♪
So refreshed, so refreshed☆
